title: On the quasi-monomiality of the $α$- and $δ$-invariants
summary: In this paper, we show that for any projective klt pair $(X,Δ)$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic \(0\) and any big $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor $L$ on $X$, the invariants $α(X,Δ,L)$ and $δ(X,Δ,L)$ are computed by quasi-monomial valuations, without any uncountability assumption on the base field.
